newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil in propane supply deal with Norway's Elkem.
newsitem.headline: Statoil in propane supply deal with Norway's Elkem.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) will begin deliveries in October of 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes per year of propane to Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said on Thursday.
Elkem's Mosjoeen aluminium mill in northern Norway will switch from oil to propane.
The gas will be moved by rail from Statoil's rock cavern store at Stenungstund in southwest Sweden. Statoil has laid an 800-metre long spur line from Mosjoeen station to the mill.

Elkem will also change fuel at its Lista aluminium mill in southern Norway. Statoil will supply around 5,000 tonnes per year of propane to the plant by road from the Kaarstoe terminal north of Stavanger, the company said.
